_readme: Reference repo config (written by `foreman onboard`, edited by hand or via the factoryd config endpoint). models.default applies to every stage until overridden; stage keys: plan, implement, review, acceptance (the drain-time PRD walk). fallback entries are 'provider/model[:thinking]' strings tried in order on provider errors (timeouts are NOT retried on another model — a hung stream is a host problem). required_checks: names of GitHub checks that must pass; ["*"] (the onboard default) requires every check the PR reports and stays inert when the repo has no CI; [] disables the CI gate. Also editable at runtime: POST /repos/<slug>/config. scenario.ports are RESERVED across all repos (the onboard planner widens the window and skips live listeners + docker publishes); runtime/holdout are file names relative to this directory. skip_labels: issues with any of these labels are never claimed (the factory's own factory:needs-info gate label is always skipped). trusted_authors: GitHub logins whose issues intake may claim, on top of the repo owner and the factory's own gh account (both always trusted); an issue opened by anyone else is skipped and shows up as untrusted-author in the idle receipt, because issue text becomes agent prompts. limits.daily_attempts: implement attempts per repo per UTC day; once reached, the chain stops until the next UTC day (0 = no ceiling). origin_url: override the clone URL (private repos with a token, or test fixtures). env: 'host' runs stages as plain processes; 'compose' runs every stage as root inside the product's own docker-compose worker service (compose_file is resolved in the worktree) or in the fallback `image` with pip/uv/npm cache volumes until the repo ships a compose file — installs inside are ordinary work; the host stays clean; scenario runs are the only publishers of the reserved port pair (publishPorts is scoped to them), agent stages exercise their server container-locally. Machine modes (instabox, boxd, daytona, e2b, instavm) run every agent stage (plan, implement, review) inside a disposable per-lap machine, and run setup, start, readiness, probes and teardown in that machine against its own 127.0.0.1; nothing is port-forwarded. 'instabox' boots from env.instabox.snapshot (built once with `foreman bake <slug>`; falls back to `template` until baked). 'boxd' boots from env.boxd.snapshot (default factory-base-boxd-r1; a first bake boots it read-only and saves `<slug>-base`). 'daytona', 'e2b' and 'instavm' boot from env.<platform>.snapshot with env.<platform>.bake as the bake script (DAYTONA_API_KEY / E2B_API_KEY / INSTAVM_API_KEY). pass_env forwards host env vars into the container/machine when present (model keys, GITHUB_TOKEN). env.<platform>.snapshot: the TOKEN 'shared-base' (recommended) resolves VPS-side via state/base-snapshot.json to THIS platform's fleet dev base (`foreman base bake` records one per platform), never a versioned name; a per-repo `foreman bake` layers on the configured alias and switches the repo to `<slug>-base`; a literal snapshot name is for repos with their own fork. scheduling.spill_over may run a lap on any machine platform.

acceptance._readme: PRD-delivery acceptance (docs/acceptance.md), all opt-in. e2e: the verify-stage gate — run the repo's authored browser suite (state/repos/<slug>/e2e/) in the lap's product-up window and block the merge on a real test failure (an infra skip retries next lap); prd_check: when the backlog drains, walk the stored PRD (prd.md, written at backlog slice time) against the live product with agent-browser and file [prd-gap] issues; security: scan merged main with penthera after every merge and file [security] findings at or above severity_floor. security_public (default true) files and shows those findings on PUBLIC repos too — a repo with a sensitive tracker opts out with false (the scan still runs and receipts). e2e and prd_check need a browser toolchain: host/compose repos install it with `foreman host-tools`, machine repos on the shared dev base (`foreman base bake`) already carry it; a per-repo snapshot gets it via a re-`foreman bake <slug>`.
